## Decisions

- Use slate, cool gray, and blue; no green colors.
- Prefer icons, visual workflows, and real-data charts to explanatory text blocks. Keep essential labels and evidence semantics.


- Keep one compact component scale: consistent white panels, aligned headers, inline icons, and restrained data graphics. Avoid large icon tiles and competing card treatments.
